2026-10-23-26.title: Drop and paste files in task comments
2026-10-23-26.body: Now you can drag files onto the comments of a task, or paste a picture into its comment box. The files go the same way as with the Attach files button. A file that you drop by mistake next to a chat or the comments no longer opens in place of Madar.

2026-10-23-27.title: Quiet notices and Mark as unread
2026-10-23-27.body: In Chrome and Edge, a desktop notice no longer shows while you look at Madar. The line "Waits for your reply" is gone. Now you can mark a chat as unread. Point at the chat, press the three dots, then press Mark as unread. On a phone, use the menu at the top of the chat. The chat stays bold until you open it again.

2026-10-23-28.title: Frame your profile picture
2026-10-23-28.body: Now you can move and zoom a new profile picture before you save it. Choose a picture in Settings. Drag it inside the circle. Move the slider to zoom. Then press Save.

2026-10-23-29.title: Change the stage of a task in a template
2026-10-23-29.body: Now you can pick the stage of a task in a project template. Open the task and use the Stage field. This works for a new task and for an old task. The days of an old task stay as they are. A note tells you when they no longer fit the stage.

profile.frameHint: Drag the picture to move it. Use the slider to zoom.

projectTemplates.taskOutside: The days of this to-do are outside the days of its stage. Change the start day, or the days of the stage.
